title: Wayfare Rides Fare Terms: Upfront Fares, Recalculation and Member Discounts
content:
## Clause 1 — When the fare is charged

On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** the fare is charged once, when the trip completes, at the rates of the ride option the trip was requested under. Only a trip whose system record shows it completed carries a fare; driver cancellations and unfulfilled requests never produce a fare.

## Clause 2 — The upfront fare and when it is recalculated

The upfront fare (which already includes the booking fee) stands, even when the trip turns out shorter, unless the rider changed the route or the actual miles or the actual minutes exceed the estimate by more than the ride option's upfront recalculation threshold (in percent); in those cases the fare is recalculated from the actual miles and minutes.

| Rider changed the route | Actual miles more than the threshold above the estimate | Actual minutes more than the threshold above the estimate | Fare |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | any | recalculated |
| No | Yes | any | recalculated |
| No | No | Yes | recalculated |
| No | No | No | upfront fare stands |

## Clause 3 — The recalculated fare

A recalculated fare is the larger of the ride option's minimum fare and the time-and-distance fare, plus the ride option's booking fee. The time-and-distance fare is the base fare plus the per-mile rate times the actual miles plus the per-minute rate times the actual minutes, that sum multiplied by the busy-time multiplier recorded at the request, then plus the option surcharge and, for a 2-seat Wayfare Shared request, the second seat surcharge (charged once for the second seat). The booking fee is added after the comparison with the minimum fare and is never multiplied.

The fare charge records its fare basis: **upfront** when the upfront fare stood, **recalculated** when it was recalculated above the minimum, and **minimum fare** when the minimum fare applied.

## Clause 4 — Wayfare Pass member discount

When the rider's Wayfare Pass membership in force at the request is in trial, active or pending cancellation status and the ride option is in the plan's member discount options, the member discount — the Wayfare Pass plan's member discount percent, applied to the fare excluding the booking fee and rounded half up to the cent — is taken off and recorded on the fare charge as the member discount amount; otherwise the member discount amount is $0.00. The amount charged is the fare (upfront or recalculated) less the member discount amount, rounded half up to the cent.

## Clause 5 — Ride credits and what the fare charge carries

Pass ride credits pay part or all of the charge only when the rider has switched credits on for the trip; the charge amount is the same either way, and the credits used are recorded on the fare charge. The fare charge names the Pass membership only when a Pass benefit (the discount or ride credit earning) applied to it. Wait time, tolls, airport fees, Priority Pickup and tips are separate charges and never part of the fare.

## Worked figures (all inputs hypothetical)

*Recalculation.* Hypothetical rates: base fare $2.00, $1.00 per mile, $0.30 per minute, booking fee $3.00, minimum fare $10.00, no surcharges, threshold 25 percent. Estimate 9 miles; actual 12 miles and 25 minutes; multiplier recorded at the request 1.2. Twelve miles exceed 9 miles by more than 25 percent, so the fare is recalculated: the time-and-distance fare is $2.00 plus $12.00 plus $7.50, that is $21.50, multiplied by 1.2, giving $25.80; the larger of $10.00 and $25.80 is $25.80; plus the $3.00 booking fee the fare is $28.80, basis recalculated.

*Minimum fare.* Same hypothetical rates; the rider added a stop, actual 3 miles and 8 minutes, multiplier 1.0: the time-and-distance fare is $7.40, below $10.00, so the fare is $10.00 plus $3.00, that is $13.00, basis minimum fare.

*Member discount.* A hypothetical upfront fare of $28.80 including a $3.00 booking fee stands; the plan's member discount percent is a hypothetical 10 percent and the ride option is listed: 10 percent of $25.80 is $2.58, so $26.22 is charged and $2.58 recorded as the member discount amount.
